Social Media & Marketing Coordinator Job at Strategic Outsourcing Limited




        
    

        
        Strategic Outsourcing Limited (SOL) is a Nigerian workforce solutions company providing personnel outsourcing, recruitment, payroll administration, and workforce support services. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos,
Employment Type: Full-tim

Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for someone who understands the fast-paced nature of restaurant operations, is creative, highly organized, and can independently manage day-to-day social media activities while coordinating with our design and operations teams.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing social media calendars, coordinating content creation, scheduling posts, engaging with customers online, supporting restaurant promotions and events, and ensuring all digital platforms remain current and aligned with our brand standards.


The key requirements are as follows


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor’s Degree
	Experience: 1–3 years in social media and digital marketing
	Preferred Industry: Hospitality, restaurant, food & beverage, or lifestyle
	Key Skills: Content coordination, social media management, customer engagement, digital marketing, and promotion/event support.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Etihad Airways
content:
Etihad Airways, the national airline of the UAE, was formed in 2003 to bring “Abu Dhabi to the World”. Over the years, we have grown into Etihad Aviation Group, a diversified global aviation and travel company, which is one of the world’s most acclaimed industry brands.

Our airline flies to over 84 destinations with a fleet of over 100 Airbus and Boeing aircraft, serving 18.6 million passengers a year and carrying 682,000 tonnes of cargo in 2018.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Airport Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
     

            
    




	Let your career take off with the World’s Leading Airline, Etihad Airways. Work in the forefront of the airline and travel industry, with the airline that has reimagined the flying experience through its pioneering products and services.
	As an Airport Manager, you will lead, plan and direct the airport operation, overseeing team and service provider performance. Ensure financial, customer service, quality, safety and security objectives are delivered in accordance with all applicable safety, security, regulatory and company requirements and standards. Lead and manage all elements of operations while on duty.


Accountabilities


	Direct and oversee all passenger and aircraft handling operations on a management and shift basis, ensuring adherence to all arrival/departure checklists, brand requirements, company policy/procedures and regulatory requirements
	Actively participate in the daily operation, working shifts including weekends and/or public holidays, where required, to deliver the local operation
	Responsible for the effective management of safety and security outcomes through safety and security promotion, hazard identification and risk assessment, safety, security and compliance monitoring and reporting
	Ensure all flight editing and special guest requirements are met, including but not limited to assessment, planning and coordination of VIP/MAAS, PRM and special category guests
	Deliver, maintain and rehearse station emergency response plan, disruption planning, diversion/delay handling and business continuity plans
	Accountable for on time performance including management, mitigation, accurate reporting and follow-up of delays
	Accountable for airport ancillary sales performance, promotion, coordination and process compliance monitoring
	Accountable for promotion, delivery, monitoring and reporting on customer service-related standards, including performance against associated KPIs
	Perform the role of Local Security Contact Officer


Qualifications


	Degree level education desirable (A-level or baccalaureate equivalent) or relevant industry experience, with a demonstrable knowledge of leadership, project management and business solutions skills
	7-9 years of relevant experience in a leadership or senior management capacity with exposure to global business best practice
	Previous exposure to highly pressured and multicultural environment in a management/supervisory role within a shift environment required
	Proven ability to lead and drive results and communicate internally and externally on a large scale across multiple channels
	Previous regional or international exposure highly advantageous


Click here to apply online

 Recruitment Fraud Alert 


	Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group.
	We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process.
	Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.


 

 

2.) Duty Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos
Division: Operations & Guest Experience

Job Description


	Let your career take off with the World’s Leading Airline, Etihad Airways. Work in the forefront of the airline and travel industry, with the airline that has reimagined the flying experience through its pioneering products and services.
	As a Duty Supervisor, you will plan, direct, and supervise the airport operation, overseeing team and service provider performance. You will ensure financial, customer service, quality, safety, and security objectives are delivered in accordance with all applicable safety, security, regulatory and company requirements and standards. And supervise all elements of operations while on duty.


Accountabilities


	Oversee all passenger and aircraft handling operations on a shift basis, ensuring adherence to all arrival/departure checklists, brand requirements, company policy/procedures and regulatory requirements
	Responsible for the effective management of safety and security outcomes on a shift basis through hazard identification, safety and compliance monitoring and reporting
	Ensure all flight editing and special guest requirements are met, including but not limited to assessment, planning and coordination of VIP/MAAS, PRM and special category guests
	Effectively liaise with Guest Control, Network Control and SOC to manage operational disruption recovery and reduce impact to guest service and operational integrity
	Deliver, maintain, and rehearse station emergency response plan, disruption planning, diversion/delay handling and business continuity plans
	Responsible for on time performance on a shift basis including coordination, mitigation, accurate reporting, and follow-up of delays
	Airport ancillary sales promotion, coordination, process compliance monitoring and adherence to associated targets
	Responsible for promotion, delivery, monitoring and reporting on customer service-related standards, including performance against associated KPIs
	Ensuring adherence to local authority requirements, including but not limited to arrival/departure documentation and reporting
	Make day-to-day operational decisions to manage and mitigate operational safety and security-related risks on a shift basis at station level, through effective evaluation and decision-making based on conditions, hazards, and threats
	Identification and reporting of safety and security-related occurrences and hazards in accordance with company procedures and local regulation


Qualifications


	Degree level education desirable (A-level or baccalaureate equivalent) or relevant industry experience, with a demonstrable knowledge of frontline service delivery and communication skills
	Previous exposure to highly pressured and multicultural environment in a supervisory role within a shift environment required
	5-7 years of experience within service, hospitality, airline, or retail industry, with a relevant knowledge of aviation, travel industry and/or airport policies
	Mature personality with outstanding communication skills, supervisory skills, and passion to deliver service
	Ability to balance guest-centric focus and corporate interest while maintaining highest safety and security standards and coordinating teams and service providers on shift


Click here to apply online

 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

SourcingQualified Talent Through Staffing Agencies


	Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group.
	We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process.
	Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.


 

3.) Sales Representative

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	We’re looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Sales Representative to help grow Etihad Airways’ presence and performance in the Nigerian market.
	This is a hands-on sales role where you’ll take ownership of a portfolio of customers, build strong relationships across the travel trade and corporate market, and identify new opportunities to grow revenue and market share.
	You’ll combine relationship building with commercial insight – understanding your customers, analyzing the market and competitors, and turning opportunities into measurable sales results.
	For someone who enjoys winning business, developing accounts, and working toward ambitious targets, this is an opportunity to represent Etihad in an important market and contribute directly to our continued growth.


What you’ll be doing


	Develop and execute sales plans across your assigned accounts to achieve revenue and commercial targets.
	Manage and grow relationships with existing customers while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities.
	Build strong relationships with travel agencies, corporate customers, and other key commercial partners, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor.
	Analyze customer potential, market trends, and competitor activity to identify where the strongest revenue opportunities exist.
	Maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities and take ownership of progressing them from initial engagement through to conversion.
	Use available data, commercial insights, and sales tools to prioritize activity and improve account performance.
	Negotiate and manage commercial agreements with customers, balancing customer requirements with Etihad’s commercial objectives.
	Work closely with internal stakeholders and Etihad partners to develop customer solutions, support commercial initiatives, and unlock new opportunities.
	Keep customers informed of relevant Etihad products, services, and promotions and identify opportunities to grow their business with us.
	Maintain accurate and current customer and sales activity within Etihad’s CRM and use this information to support effective account management.


Qualifications
What we’re looking for:


	Above all, we’re looking for a sales professional with the energy, commercial mindset, and determination to deliver results.


You’ll ideally bring:


	A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
	At least three years of relevant experience in sales, account management, or business development.
	A demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales, revenue, or commercial targets.
	Airline sales experience is strongly preferred; however, we’re also interested in candidates from the broader travel industry or high-performing B2B sales environments.
	Strong account management and business development capability, with the ability to identify, develop, and convert new opportunities.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to become a trusted commercial partner to your customers.
	Commercial and analytical capability, with the confidence to use data and market insights to make effective sales decisions.
	The ability to work effectively across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
	A proactive, energetic, and resilient approach, with the motivation to succeed in a target-driven environment.
	A strong understanding of the Nigerian and/or wider West African travel and commercial market is highly desirable.
	If you’re motivated by building relationships, winning new business, and delivering measurable commercial results, this is an opportunity to play an important role in Etihad’s continued growth in Nigeria and the wider region.


Recruitment Process:
The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps: 

All applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team


	Shortlisted applicants will be invited to completed a recorded video interview via our third-party platform HireVue.
	This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to.
	It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses. 
	After a review of completed video interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager.
	This interview will include the completion of a job-related case study and presentation to the hiring team.
	Finalists may be invited to a follow up meeting with additional members of the hiring team.
	All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.
